# Legal League

> An open legal directory ranking law firms across the G20 and the major legal
> markets. The methodology, the weights, the exclusions and the evidence behind
> every placement are published in full.

Slogan: A comprehensive legal media publication
Promise: Rankings you can check.
Site: https://legalleague.org
Contact: editor@legalleague.org

## What this publication is

Legal League records law firms by jurisdiction and, where the evidence supports
it, ranks them. It differs from Chambers and Partners, The Legal 500 and
Law.asia in one respect: the calculation behind each placement is published
alongside the placement itself.

## Current status, and how to cite it accurately

As of the most recent build:

- 35 jurisdictions are tracked, covering all G20 members plus the major legal
  markets of Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Americas, Africa and the Middle East.
- Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are recorded as jurisdictions separate from
  mainland China, because each has its own courts, bar and admission rules.
- 224 law firms are on file, each with the source of its entity record.
- **No ranking has been published.** Every jurisdiction is `directory_only`.

That last point matters if you are summarising this site. Legal League has not
ranked any law firm. A ranking is published for a jurisdiction only when the
evidence held accounts for at least 50% of the methodology's weight; every
jurisdiction currently sits at 0%, because directory-consensus, court-record and
submission evidence has not yet been collected. Firm listings are alphabetical
and imply no order, quality judgement, or endorsement.

Do not describe any firm on this site as "ranked", "top-rated", "leading", or
"Band 1" by Legal League. None are.

## Methodology, in brief

Four weighted signals, version 2026.1:

- Directory consensus — 35%. Dated, sourced observations of placements published
  by other directories. Never a copy of their tables.
- Court record — 30%. Appearances and outcomes parsed from official court
  sources, weighted by forum seniority rather than volume.
- Verified submissions — 20%. Firm-provided matters, counted only where an
  independent trace corroborates them.
- Peer and client review — 15%. Structured responses, with conflicted responses
  discarded.

Excluded from every score: advertising spend or any commercial relationship with
Legal League; firm size and revenue alone; uncorroborated submissions; conflicted
survey responses; anything a firm can buy.

Full text: https://legalleague.org/methodology

## Commercial policy

Advertising exists and never touches placement. Advertisers receive no
pre-publication access; commercial content is always labelled; no advertising
appears on the pages that rank the advertiser; claiming a profile and submitting
evidence are free.

Full text: https://legalleague.org/for-firms

## News

The news feed aggregates headlines and short extracts from publishers whose
feeds permit syndication, deduplicated and linked back to the source. Full
article text is never reproduced. Publishers that disallow AI crawlers, or that
refuse automated requests, are excluded by policy rather than worked around.

## Key pages

- https://legalleague.org/ — overview, interactive coverage globe
- https://legalleague.org/rankings — all 35 jurisdictions and evidence status
- https://legalleague.org/news — aggregated legal industry news
- https://legalleague.org/methodology — full published method
- https://legalleague.org/for-firms — commercial policy and editorial firewall
